title: Transitivity of the symmetry group
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be invariant under some coordinate permutation carrying any specified coordinate to any other. Then, for every pair of coordinates $i,j$, a symmetry of $f$ carries $i$ to $j$.
